name: activity-tree-intent-geometry
description: A 200-character intent cannot starve a short delegate name or hide its own Open control. Real phone Sheet insets at the issue's 320/360/390/430px viewports through nine nested groups, a wide 900px row whose full name and 60% meta cap must be untouched, and Latin, full-width CJK and emoji labels plus an `xl` font-scale row, because the name floor is a text-relative budget rather than a digit measurement. Every row is measured twice in the same run, with the floor on and off, so the rows the floor did not rescue are proved unmoved.

mutation.declaration: activitypanel.module.css: remove the .denseRow:has(.denseMeta[data-intent="true"]) .denseName rule (the name-priority rule that stops the name shrinking below its own text)
mutation.note: Chrome exited 1 with the name-priority rule deleted and the name back to the shrinkable flex: 0 1 auto: 320px/depth 0 fell to 5.70px against its 12.58px glyph-plus-ellipsis prefix with 162px free, 320px/depth 1 to 5.17px against 12.58px, and 320px/depth 0 CJK to 3.61px against 22.80px. This is the rule that actually sizes the name, so removing it reproduces the starvation the case exists to catch. An earlier recorded mutation removed .denseMeta's flex-shrink: 100, which changed nothing once the name could not shrink - the defect this replaces. Stylesheet restored byte-for-byte before the passing run.

previous.note: Superseded: with the name's shrink factor at zero and the fixed controls at their minimums, that override could not change the outcome in the final fixture, so the recorded mutation did not reproduce the starvation it claimed.

previous.declaration: activitypanel.module.css: remove .denseMeta's flex-shrink: 100 with the name still shrinkable
